title: On Kissing the child on both cheeks
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：kiss　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 kiss 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the shopkeeper ① kissed the child on both cheeks year after year, and every buyer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the shopkeeper ② kisses the child on both cheeks for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ kiss the child on both cheeks at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ kissed the child on both cheeks before — a line in the account for July 1944 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Kissing the child on both cheeks year after year, the shopkeeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ kiss the top of the reeds for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Kiss the top of the reeds at once and never mention it again.

By 1957 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the account, and a new buyer from the next shop ⑧ kisses the top of the reeds year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ kissed the child on both cheeks again when nobody else would.

⑩ To kiss the child on both cheeks, my mother said in 1962, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody kisses the child on both cheeks for the whole place again and somebody must kiss the child on both cheeks year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 亲吻（一般过去式 kissed the child on both cheeks：1950 年掌柜头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 亲吻（一般现在 kisses the child on both cheeks：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 亲吻（不定式 to kiss the child on both cheeks：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 亲吻（过去完成时 had kissed the child on both cheeks：1944 年七月的账本上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 亲吻（动名词 kissing the child on both cheeks 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 轻拂（kiss the top of the reeds：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去轻拂水面轻拂过芦苇尖）
G. v. 轻拂（kiss the top of the reeds：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 亲吻（后段两处：新来的买主照例 kisses the top of the reeds，而母亲又一次 kissed the child on both cheeks）

answers.why: kiss 意为“亲吻”，1950 年掌柜年年地亲吻在那孩子两边脸颊上亲了亲，那是铺子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 kissed。
kiss 意为“亲吻”，自那以后掌柜替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 kisses。
kiss 意为“亲吻”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯亲吻在那孩子两边脸颊上亲了亲”，此处为不定式 to kiss the child on both cheeks。
kiss 意为“亲吻”，账本里 七月 那行字说明早在 1957 年之前就有人亲吻过，故用过去完成时 had kissed。
kiss 意为“亲吻”，掌柜说“亲吻在那孩子两边脸颊上亲了亲这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 kissing the child on both cheeks 作主语。
kiss 意为“轻拂”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去轻拂水面轻拂过芦苇尖”，should ever 之后用原形 kiss the top of the reeds。
kiss 意为“轻拂”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻轻拂水面轻拂过芦苇尖（kiss the top of the reeds at once），以后再也不要提起。
kiss 意为“亲吻”，新来的买主每个月份都照例轻拂水面轻拂过芦苇尖，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 kisses。
kiss 意为“亲吻”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地亲吻在那孩子两边脸颊上亲了亲，用一般过去式 kissed 叙述。
kiss 意为“亲吻”，结尾那句是母亲 1962 年的话：要亲吻在那孩子两边脸颊上亲了亲，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和铺子记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，掌柜年年地亲吻在那孩子两边脸颊上亲了亲；铺子里每一个买主都说这是头一回。（kissed the child on both cheeks）
多年以后，掌柜仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（kisses the child on both cheeks）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯亲吻在那孩子两边脸颊上亲了亲这件事本身。（to kiss the child on both cheeks）
早在 1944 年就有人亲吻在那孩子两边脸颊上亲了亲，七月那天账本上的一行字就是证据。（had kissed the child on both cheeks）
掌柜说过，年年地亲吻在那孩子两边脸颊上亲了亲这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（kissing the child on both cheeks 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻轻拂水面轻拂过芦苇尖，以后再也不要提起。（kiss the top of the reeds，祈使句）
answers: In 1950 the shopkeeper kissed the child on both cheeks year after year, and every buyer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the shopkeeper still kisses the child on both cheeks for the whole place without being asked.
My mother said later that to kiss the child on both cheeks at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had kissed the child on both cheeks long before 1957, and the line in the account for July proves it.
Kissing the child on both cheeks year after year, the shopkeeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Kiss the top of the reeds at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 kiss 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the shopkeeper kissed the child on both cheeks year after year, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the shopkeeper kisses the child on both cheeks for the whole place whenever the shop asks.
Kissing the child on both cheeks year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever kiss the top of the reeds for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new buyer from the next shop kisses the top of the reeds year after year every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother kissed the child on both cheeks again, and the shop remembered that half.
